'''Tearfin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of these smugglers is my mark. I think. I'm not sure. I've been tracking him for some time and just now caught up with him here in this city.|Tearfin, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tearfin received a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] to locate a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who stole a crate of equipment. The equipment had a [[transponder]], so the bounty hunter easily traced her mark to a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the thief discovered the transponder and realized that he was being tracked, so he turned off the transponder, and blended in with a group of other fellow smugglers within the Tatooinan city. Tearfin located the group of smugglers, but because she did not know what what the identity of the thief, she was not able to know which one was her mark. The group included six smugglers, namely [[Rh'klin]], [[Parugga]], [[D'lonis]], [[Barosk]], [[Klaphini]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Himfan]]. The bounty hunter interrogated all of the smugglers but, unfortunately, she failed to find any information, basically because all of the smugglers simply blamed each other. Among them, Tearfin only knew Captain Himfan and she was convinced that she could trust him. Fortunately for Tearfin, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] seeking to become a [[Hero of Tatooine]] found Tearfin, and offered to [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|help]]. Tearfin stubbornly conceded that she could use some help, and allowed the spacer to interrogate the smugglers. After a grueling interrogation, the spacer finally determined who was the smuggler who stole the equipment. The spacer informed Tearfin of this finding, and was awarded the [[Mark of Intellect]] for the successful interrogation.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tearfin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

[[File:Tearfin_and_smugglers.png|thumb|right|250px|Tearfin harboring a randomly generated name in an early version of the "Hero of Tatooine" questline.]]
Tearfin was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> This NPC periodically spawned in random cities across Tatooine, along with six smugglers. Players taking part in the "Intellect" segment of the "Hero of Tatooine" had to interrogate the smugglers to determine which one was Tearfin's mark. The identity of the culprit varied among the six smugglers each time the quest was reset.<ref name="SWG" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 24|Publish 24]]," on [[October 18]], [[2005]], Tearfin and the smugglers were given proper names<ref name="SWG-2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> to replace randomly generated names.<ref name="SWG" />

The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]]<ref name="SWG-2005" /> but the "Intellect" segment was not altered.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
